question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1. ​
solution:
The correct answer is** 'has done'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate answer for the first blank is** 'has done'.**
 
• The most appropriate title for the given blank is** 'History of India's Space Journey'.**
 
• The **present perfect **is often used for an action that started at some time in the past and is still continuing **now**.
 
 
• *Example: He **has lived** in Canada for five years.*
 
 
 
• If we connect the above rule in the given context, we can say that the breakthroughs are still continuing.
 
• Thus, the correct answer is Option 3.

 

**Correct Passage:__** *In its 47 years of history, ISRO **has done** breakthrough work in the field of technology and even (2) ______ many vehicles into space. (3) ______ the last 47 years, ISRO has improvised and developed technology, launching (4) ______ indigenously created vehicles into space (5) ______ form a part of the Indian space journey.*
